SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'ISDS') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY BUYER, DOC_NO ORDER BY BUYER, DOC_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO, DOC_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, LEGACY_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, PLANT FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$' ORDER BY DOC_SEQ
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND DOC_NO = '$G_RS.DOC_NO$'
